snacks.name: Lemon & cumin chana
procedure: Cook chickpeas until tender, or rinse ready-cooked chickpeas.
Wash and chop the vegetables using clean equipment.
Combine with lemon and cumin; keep added salt modest.
Serve promptly; chill leftovers promptly.
snacks.nutrition_note: A pulse-and-vegetable alternative to a deep-fried snack.
snacks.pairing_style: Crisp cucumber, soft chickpeas, citrus finish.
snacks.allergen_note: Listed allergens reflect this proposed recipe, not a guarantee. Check ingredient labels, individual allergies and kitchen cross-contact.

snacks.name: Roasted peanut koshimbir
procedure: Wash and chop cucumber and coriander.
Add a small portion of unsalted roasted peanuts.
Dress with lemon; do not add sweet bottled dressing by default.
Check nut allergies and cross-contact before serving.
snacks.nutrition_note: Nuts are energy-dense: offer a small portion, not an unlimited bowl.
snacks.pairing_style: Crunch with a fresh citrus contrast.
snacks.allergen_note: Listed allergens reflect this proposed recipe, not a guarantee. Check ingredient labels, individual allergies and kitchen cross-contact.

snacks.name: Cooked moong chaat
procedure: Cook moong beans thoroughly rather than serving raw sprouts.
Wash and chop vegetables separately from raw animal foods.
Mix with herbs and lemon; add chilli to preference.
Serve fresh and refrigerate leftovers promptly.
snacks.nutrition_note: A pulse-based option; no detox or hangover-prevention claim.
snacks.pairing_style: Soft beans with bright herbs and acidity.
snacks.allergen_note: Listed allergens reflect this proposed recipe, not a guarantee. Check ingredient labels, individual allergies and kitchen cross-contact.

snacks.name: Chickpea sundal bowl
procedure: Use fully cooked chickpeas.
Warm curry leaves and cumin in a small amount of oil.
Toss with chickpeas and a little coconut.
Check every ingredient and keep cooked food at safe serving temperatures.
snacks.nutrition_note: Use modest oil and coconut; nutrition depends on the recipe and portion.
snacks.pairing_style: Warm spice, gentle sweetness, tender pulses.
snacks.allergen_note: Listed allergens reflect this proposed recipe, not a guarantee. Check ingredient labels, individual allergies and kitchen cross-contact.

snacks.name: Pepper & lime tofu bites
procedure: Check the tofu label and soy allergy suitability.
Cut tofu and washed peppers into bite-sized pieces.
Bake or pan-cook with a little oil until thoroughly heated.
Finish with lime and pepper; serve with vegetables.
snacks.nutrition_note: A plant-protein option; avoid salty bottled marinades by default.
snacks.pairing_style: Peppery, citrus-led, soft with browned edges.
snacks.allergen_note: Listed allergens reflect this proposed recipe, not a guarantee. Check ingredient labels, individual allergies and kitchen cross-contact.

snacks.name: Herbed paneer & peppers
procedure: Check milk allergy suitability and refrigeration.
Cut paneer and washed peppers.
Cook with a little oil and the spices until thoroughly heated.
Finish with fresh herbs; include vegetables rather than only cheese.
snacks.nutrition_note: Portion matters; not a low-fat or low-calorie claim.
snacks.pairing_style: Creamy texture with herbs and citrus.
snacks.allergen_note: Listed allergens reflect this proposed recipe, not a guarantee. Check ingredient labels, individual allergies and kitchen cross-contact.

snacks.name: Banana-leaf fish plate
procedure: Use safely sourced fish and keep it chilled before cooking.
Prepare separately from ready-to-eat vegetables.
Wrap with ginger and cook until fish reaches a verified safe internal temperature using local food-safety guidance.
Check bones and serve with cooked vegetables.
snacks.nutrition_note: An alternative to deep-frying, not a promise of a healthier alcoholic meal.
snacks.pairing_style: Gentle aromatics, flaky texture, lime finish.
snacks.allergen_note: Listed allergens reflect this proposed recipe, not a guarantee. Check ingredient labels, individual allergies and kitchen cross-contact.

snacks.name: Roasted vegetable crunch
procedure: Wash the vegetables and use clean utensils.
Cut into even pieces and coat lightly with oil and cumin.
Roast until cooked; adjust texture for the diner.
Finish with lemon and serve without a heavy salty sauce.
snacks.nutrition_note: A vegetable-forward plate; combine with pulses or another suitable protein if desired.
snacks.pairing_style: Roasted sweetness, crisp edges, gentle spice.
snacks.allergen_note: Listed allergens reflect this proposed recipe, not a guarantee. Check ingredient labels, individual allergies and kitchen cross-contact.

ai.prompt_template: Create an original adult-oriented cultural food illustration of {snack} in {region}. Show listed ingredients accurately, no brands, no health claims for alcohol, no intoxication or minors. Respect community consent and mark synthetic imagery. Human review is required.

safety.audience: Food mode is available without alcohol content. Cultural alcohol content is for adults of the applicable local legal drinking age; the prototype acknowledgement is not legal age verification.
safety.health: Alcohol carries health risks; food does not make drinking safe. These snack ideas are not a medical diet, detox, hangover remedy or endorsement of drinking.
safety.production_scope: Educational overview only; no DIY distillation, equipment setup, time/temperature recipes or purification-safety promises.
safety.serving: Do not serve alcohol to minors or intoxicated people; verify local law. Do not drink and drive.
safety.claims: No universal healthy/best-snack ranking, calorie figures, verified ABV, historic origin dates or upcoming events are invented.
safety.rights: Community knowledge, photos, oral histories, brands, venues and voices need consent/rights review before publication.
